tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: thugs rje chen po'i bka' srung lha chen dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

thugs rje chen por phyag 'tshal lo: de'i yang sprul lha chen dbang phyug sgrub pa la: sa dmar po'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng: me ri rdor rwa sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar pho brang zla gam dmar po sgo gcig nang du pad+ma 'dab bzhi lcags kyus mtshan pa bri: de'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan myos byed dam: lan tshwa 'bru dang me tog gis bkang ba'i khar dar dmar la bris pa'i sku gzugs: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar rtsa sngags/ oṃ ma hā de ba hūm̐: u māḥde bī hriṃ: rtsibs bzhi la: hā badz+ra ḍā ki nī: ri rat+na ḍā ki nī: ni pad+ma ḍā ki nī: sa karma ḍā ki nī: kun gyi mthar: pā shaṃ ku ru ho: mu khyud la: lha chen dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'dir bzhugs nas dbang sdud kyi phrin las mdzad du gsol: zhes bris la pad+ma rā ga la: hrīḥbris pa: zangs las byas pa'i srid pa'i liṅga cong zhis bkang ba: me long: lcags kyu: bum pa sin+dhu ras bkang ba: dkor cha dang bcas te zangs kyi gwa'ur bcug: dar dmar gyi gur phub: gtor ma sha chang sogs mchod rdzas rgyas par bsham: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa srung 'khor mtshams gcod la sogs byas nas rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su bsgom: gtor mchod rnams byin gyis brlab: mdun du lha tshogs bskyed cing spyan drang: mchod bstod byas la: bzlas pa 'bum phrag gcig bya 'o: 'grub pa'i rtags byung na gtor ma rgyas par 'bul: lha rnams rten la bstims te mdzod kyi phugs su bzhag la rgyun du mchod bstod bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: las sbyor ni: pho mo nyal po byas pa'i sa dang: smad 'tshong ma'i 'og gi sa blangs la stegs bu zla gam byas pa'i steng nas mar brub khung zla gam bru: smad 'tshong ma'i nang gos la bsgrub bya'i liṅga bris pa'i snying gar nṛ dang ming gi mthar: aṃ ku sha dza: pā shaṃ ku ru hring hring: zhes bris pa bcug: de'i steng du lha chen gyi gtor ma bsham:

dkyil 'khor du bskyed cing bzlas pa'i mthar: rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros: dbang phyug gi thugs kar phog par bsam la: hūm̐: khams gsum kun gyi yid 'gugs pa'i: lha chen dbang phyug u mār bcas: kun la dbang sgyur mthu rtsal can: sems med pa yang 'gugs byed na: yid dang ldan pa smros ci dgos: khyod kyi mthu rtsal dus la bab: gang la bya ba khyed kyis shes: de yi lus ngag yid gsum la: khyod kyis chags pa'i 'od zhags 'phongs: 'gugs byed lcags kyus snying nas drongs: srid pa'i rlung gi zhags pas chings: skad cig yud tsam gnas 'di ru: da lta nyid du khug la shog: sgo gsum 'khor dang longs spyod bcas: bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod: zhes brjod pas thugs rgyud rab tu bskul te chags pa'i dbang gis yab yum sbyor mtshams: lcags kyu'i rtse: rlung zhags rnams las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa'i dbyibs can 'phros: dmigs bya pho yi spyi bo dang: mo'i gsang gnas nas zhugs dwangs ma gsum dbang du bsdus: gnas 'dir rten la thim par bsam: gtso 'khor sngags kyi mthar: che ge mo'i tsit+ta hring hring pā shaṃ ku ru ho: zhes drag tu bzlas la dmigs bya brub khung du dngos su bkug par bsam: thun bzhi ru gtor ma 'bul: las grub nas dri bzang gi shing dmar po zla gam du brtsegs pa'i hom la me sbar: nang du lha chen 'khor bcas bskyed la byin gyis brlabs pa'i myos byed lan tshwa: shing tog dar dmar: rin po che dmar po'i rigs: zhal zas rnams 'bul zhing: rgyan dang na bzar gsol bar bsam la me la bsreg: bsgrub bya bdag la bstim zhing ming byang me la bsreg: thal ba la sāts+tsha dmar po gdab bo: gtang rag 'bul zhing lha rten la bstim: gtor ma mer bsreg: stegs bu thab kyi sa la bsre 'o: des gang bsam pa thams cad dbang du 'du bas shin tu zab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000250

༁ྃ: thugs rje chen po'i bka' srung lha chen dbang phyug gi phrin las bzhugs so: 1$0000300spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: de yi yang sprul lha chen dbang phyug gi phrin las la: rang nyid thugs rje chen por bsgom: mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab: mdun du lha'i yul nyams dga' ba'i dbus su rin po che'i pho brang zla gam 'od 'bar ba'i nang du pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥlas lha chen dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po g.yas pas lcags kyu dang: g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa: chags pa'i nyams can: u māḥdamar mo g.yas me long dang: g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa: bde ba'i nyams kyis 'khril ba: yab kyi spyi bor zla tshes dang: gnyis ka dar dang rin po che me tog gi rgyan can: 'dab bzhir mkha' 'gro dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi: g.yas pas rang rtags dang: g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin pa: cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa: lha bran pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros: 'dod khams nas 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: hūm̐: khams gsum kun la dbang byed pa'i: spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa mchog: dbang phyug ma hā de ba dang: btsun mo u māḥde bī bcas: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams: nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: khyod la dgyes pa'i mchod sprin ni: gtsang ma'i mchod yon rgya chen sbreng: yan lag brgyad ldan zhabs bsil bltams: rab mdzes me tog rin chen rgyan: dri bsung bzang po'i dud pa'i sprin: snang gsal mar me nyi ltar gsal: bde ba skyed pa byug pa'i mtsho: gzugs mdzes lha mo'i zlos gar dang: lha yi zhal zas bsam mi khyab: glu dbyangs rol mo ngo mtshar ba: reg bya yab yum rol pa'i bde: a mṛ ta dang dmar chen po: dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul:

khams gsum dbang du 'du bar mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi bstan srung mthu bo che: khams gsum kun la dbang sgyur myur mgyogs can: rā ga'i mdog 'chang khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams: yid 'gugs lcags kyu dbang sdud rlung zhags bsnams: che ba'i yon tan zla tshes cod pan can: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis legs par brgyan: srid gsum yid 'gugs lha mo u māḥni: snang srid gsal ba'i las kyi me long dang: bdud rtsi'i bcud bltams bum pa 'dzin pa yi: yab yum mnyam rol bde ba chen pos tshims: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las rab kyi: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi las kyi pho nyar 'gyed: khyod ni lha yi rgyal po tshogs kyi rje: yab yum 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros gtso 'khor rnams la phog pas thugs dam bskul bas ci 'dod pa'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam: oṃ ma hā de ba dza: u māḥde bī hring: ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ ku ru ho: zhes bzlas gtor ma 'bul zhing: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po'i bka' srung ba: dbang phyug u māḥde bī yum: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi bcas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi 'bras chan dang: shing thog la du myos byed chang: dkar dmar sgog tsong spod kyi rigs: zhal zas longs spyod 'di bzhes la: yid la gang 'dod dbang du sdus: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: zhes bcol zhing rten la bstim pa'am: gats+tsha sa rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: mchog 'gyur bde chen gling pa'i gter ma'o/// /
